decisions.reason: After two years on the market, this psychiatric evening program appears close enough to aspiration levels and is tightly aligned with the firm's core therapeutic capabilities, so boundedly rational management would keep it.

The carpentry workshop is more peripheral to the core care business, but its fit with sheltered-workshop activities and the firm's continuing slack make retention more likely than withdrawal unless results clearly miss aspirations.

This counseling service remains a close extension of senior-care offerings and its earlier prominence suggests internal confidence, so management would likely judge it as meeting aspirations well enough to continue.

The retail shop is mission-linked but commercially less central than care services, so it carries some review risk, yet continued expansion and no clear sign of underperformance support keeping it for now.

As a newer service, meal delivery still faces more uncertainty about whether it meets aspiration levels, but its closeness to senior support and available organisational slack favor another year of continuation rather than exit.
